question: Total revenue per product category in 2025
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN categories c ON o.category_id = c.id WHERE o.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.name;

question: Top 5 employees by closed tickets last month
sql: SELECT employee_id: COUNT(*) AS closed FROM tickets WHERE closed_at >= date_trunc('month' - now()) GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY closed DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find orders with no matching invoice
sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE i.id IS NULL;

question: Average session duration per plan tier
sql: SELECT p.tier, AVG(s.duration_s) FROM sessions s JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.id GROUP BY p.tier;

question: Customers who churned in Q1 but reactivated in Q2
sql: SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE churned_q = 'Q1' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE active_q = 'Q2';

question: Daily active users for the last 30 days
sql: SELECT date(activity_at), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE activity_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Products never ordered
sql: SELECT p.id FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id);

question: Median ticket resolution time per priority
sql: SELECT priority, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY resolved_at - created_at) FROM tickets GROUP BY priority;

question: Month-over-month revenue growth
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_at) mo, SUM(amount) rev FROM payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT mo, rev, rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY mo) FROM m;
